description: For a one-placeholder formula \(A\) and term \(t\), symbol translation satisfies \(j_*(A(t))=(j_*A)(j_*t)\), using the shared bound-slot instantiation.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ChangingLanguages.map_instantiate.{u, v, u', v', w} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  {K : FirstOrder.Language} {α : Type w} (j : L →ᴸ K) (A : L.BoundedFormula α 1) (t : L.Term α) :
  j.onFormula (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.instantiate A t) =
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.instantiate (j.onBoundedFormula A) (j.onTerm t)
